message: No detected input validation: The code loads a pickle file directly and calls sort_indexes() without any schema, type, or value-range validation on the loaded dataset contents.

No detected untrusted source handling: The dataset is loaded from a local file path via pickle with no checksum, signature, or integrity verification; no remote source fetching with authentication or pinned revision is visible in the data acquisition path.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.
No detected model integrity verification: Models and datasets are loaded via pickle.load and path arguments without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, verifies expected label sets, or detects anomalous label distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (e.g., Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or applied during training.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While training and test sets are separated via MultilingualDataset, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no audit trail, and no explicit isolation enforcement beyond a simple split; predictions are dumped without integrity checks.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads dataset directly via pickle and passes it to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation on the inference inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Predictions from gfun.predict(lXte) are passed directly to dump_predictions and evaluate without any NaN guards, probability bound checks, or sanity validation.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a multilingual document classification pipeline (not an LLM text-in/text-out system), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
